name: Flag City Summer 2023

venue.name: [Findlay High School](https://fcs.org/fhs/)
venue.details: Enter through student doors located at the back of the building, accessible by an intersection on Broad Ave

information:
This competition features the return of competitive speedcubing to the Findlay, Ohio area after an almost 4 year hiatus.

**Findlay City School students, faculty, or other employees may compete free of charge. See the Registration Requirements for more information.**
